transcript:
Meeting Header: Date: 2026-12-30 10:00 AM UTC | Duration: 45 mins | Attendees: Alex Kim (Redwood AE), Priya Reddy (Redwood SE), Jorge Morales (Acme CTO), Lena Park (Acme Lead Eng), Samir Patel (Acme Product)

Summary: quick sync to review pilot results from SDK integration, structured outputs and function/tool calling. main focuses: latency, hallucination in structured outputs, error handling when external tool calls fail and auth/security questions.

00:00 Alex: ok good morning everyone thanks for joining, um i'll kick off, quick agenda - results recap, tuning notes, open issues, next steps
00:22 Jorge: thanks alex we ran the SDK integration on our staging cluster last week, got basic flows working, the function calling looked good for merchant_lookup but requests are spiking on refund flow
00:40 Priya: can you expand on spike? is it tokens or concurrency
00:50 Jorge: looks like high concurrency 200 rps at peak, latency goes from 120ms to 900ms, errors mostly 429 from the edge
01:12 Priya: likely batching config and autoscale policy, did you use the SDK client default which sets batch_window 20ms
01:28 Lena: we didn't change defaults, using node sdk 1.4, also noticed structured output sometimes returns missing fields like transaction_id or amount
01:45 Priya: yeah that's a known prompt formatting issue, and a model-decoding issue when system role is too long, we recommended schema enforcement via structured output config and the SDK provide validate_schema param
02:05 Samir: when it fails we call an external fraud-tool via tool call, sometimes the tool returns 500, sdk's tool-call retry didn't surface the error cleanly and client kept getting partial json
02:22 Alex: ok that's important, we'll capture that as action item. Priya can you talk through recommended change set for SDK and server
02:30 Priya: sure so first, bump batch_window to 5-10ms for low-latency flows and set max_batch_tokens to 1024 for refund path, second enable per-route kv-cache for prefix reuse, third - enable strict structured_output config with schema enforcement and set invalid_output_mode to 'reject' so we return explicit error instead of partial json
03:05 Jorge: that sounds good, but any impact on cost with lower batch window
03:12 Priya: lower batch window increases per-token cost slightly but we can offset by increasing cache hit rates and using quantized model profile for refunds since sequence length is short
03:35 Lena: can we run a quick A/B on hosted vs dedicated to see tail latencies? we have compliance questions for data residency
03:48 Alex: yes we propose dedicated reserved nodes in eu-west for production, for pilot we can run a dedicated-like profile on hosted by pinning to model variants and region
04:02 Priya: also note the SDK recently added improved tool-call exceptions so the client gets standard error codes, upgrade to 1.5 will show clearer error semantics
04:20 Jorge: ok we will upgrade, any security docs on KMS/HSM and audit logs
04:28 Alex: i'll share SOC2 and encryption docs, we have a private deployment whitepaper and KMS integration notes
04:36 Samir: on evals, the structured output failures are about 8% of calls in our dataset, mostly missing amount field or currency mismatch
04:50 Priya: for that we'll add schema-aware prompts, increase model temperature to 0.1 for determinism and run a constrained decoding profile, also set top_p low
05:15 Lena: do we have a plan for fallback if structured output rejected - do we return human review ticket or attempt a retry
05:28 Alex: recommended fallback: first automatic retry with a different model variant, if still rejected create ticket to internal queue and increment metric 'structured_output_rejects'
05:45 Jorge: timeline - we want production by end of Q1 next year, need latencies under 200ms p95 and cost within 30% of current vendor
06:05 Priya: action items recap, we'll run benchmark with dedicated-like config and share results, also update SDK samples in repo
06:18 Alex: ok last thing, we documented a sample curl and node snippet for function calling and structured output, sending link in chat
